welcome.heading: Welcome to {app}
welcome.body: This is your game server panel: everything you rent from us lives here. We'll light up each part of it and tell you what it does. It takes about a minute.

navigation.heading: The sidebar
navigation.body: Every page of your account is one click away here.

bullets.home: {label} — your servers. You are on it now.
bullets.store: {label} — more CPU, memory and disk for your credits.
bullets.plus: {label} — better locations and priority in the start queue.
bullets.tokens: {label} — earn tokens and see where they went.

bullets.tokens: Tokens pay for {plus}; earn them on the Tokens page.
bullets.click: Click the bars or the credits to open the Resource Store, the tokens to open the Tokens page.

account.heading: Your account
account.body: Your name opens the account menu: your profile, signing out, and this tour if you want to see it again.

create.heading: Create server
create.body: This makes a new server. Pick a game, a location and a size, and it is ready a minute later.

servers.heading: Your servers
servers.body: Every server you have is a card like this one. The bar on its left shows whether it is running, the numbers what it uses right now. Click a card to open that server — let's open {name} together.

empty.heading: Your servers
empty.body: Your servers show up here, one card each, with whether they are running and what they use. You do not have one yet.

createFirst.heading: Create your first server
createFirst.body: Start here: pick a game, a location and a size. The first time you open your new server, the tour shows you around inside it.

console.heading: The console
console.body: Your server's live output: everything it prints shows up here as it happens. Type a command in the line underneath and press Enter to run it.

power.heading: Start, Restart, Stop
power.body: The power buttons for this server. Stop lets the game save and shut down cleanly; if it hangs while stopping, Stop turns into Kill.

details.heading: Name, status and address
details.body: The Address is what players type to join. Click it to copy it, then send it to your friends. CPU, memory and disk are live.

setup.heading: Finish the setup
setup.body: This server still has its setup guide waiting: it picks the Minecraft version and software and gets the server ready to play on.

sidebar.heading: Everything about this server
sidebar.body: While a server is open, the sidebar belongs to it.

bullets.files: Files — upload, edit and delete anything on the server.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.body: One page for everything about this server: rename it, give it more memory, change the version it runs, or reinstall it.

home.heading: Back to your servers

renew.question: Does a membership renew by itself?
renew.answer: No. {plus} and {plusplus} each run for the days you buy, and nothing renews by itself. Buying again before one ends adds to the time left. {plusplus} includes everything {plus} gives, so you never need both.
renew.answerAutoRenew: Only if you switch on Renew automatically for it: then it renews as it ends, at its price at the time, while your balance covers it, and you hear before it ends. Buying again before one ends adds to the time left. {plusplus} includes everything {plus} gives, so you never need both.

expiry.question: What happens when a membership ends?
expiry.answer: Servers on locations it opened move to one you can still use, and your servers burst only as far as what is left allows. Buy again before it ends to keep everything.

idle.question: Do my servers still stop when nobody uses them?
idle.answer: Yes. A membership does not change that: like every server, one nobody uses is stopped after a while, then hibernated. You can start it again from its page.
idle.answerDelete: Yes. A membership does not change that: like every server, one nobody uses is stopped after a while, then hibernated, and deleted if it stays hibernated for a long time. You can start it again from its page until then.

form.allowanceDescription: What all servers of an account may use together. 0 puts no limit on that resource. Lowering it shrinks the servers of accounts that are then over it, evenly.
form.allowanceNoprofit: noprofit.space is connected: every account gets its plan from there, these values are not used.

catalog.description: The games players can pick, in this order. Without a software variable or variants, a server runs what its egg sets up. The ports come from the egg configurations (Admin › Egg Configurations); without one, any free allocation of the node is used.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.iconDescription: A link to the picture on the game's card on the create page (https://… or /…). Without one the card shows a gamepad.
catalog.variableDescription: The egg variable the chosen software is written to.
catalog.variantDescriptionHelp: Shown under the software choice on a server's Settings › Version.

form.curseforgeKeyStored: A key is stored. Leave this empty to keep it.
form.curseforgeKeyMissing: Without a key, CurseForge is not offered as a source and jars are not matched against it. Keys come from console.curseforge.com.
form.spigotDescription: Offer SpigotMC (through Spiget) as a source of plugins on Paper servers.
form.userAgentDescription: Sent to Modrinth, CurseForge, SpigotMC and the loaders' APIs, which ask for one that names the panel. Empty: the panel's name and URL.
form.logCheckDescription: Check Minecraft servers' latest log on mclo.gs and show the problems it finds above the console. Secrets are masked before the log is sent.

form.imageDescription: The Docker image FiveM and RedM servers run on. Its fivem-runtime installs the FXServer build each server's variables ask for at every start; the Artifacts page sets them. Empty leaves servers on their egg's image, and the Artifacts page only shows what is installed.
form.enhancedDescription: Let players switch their servers to the Enhanced edition. Its txAdmin needs io_uring, which Docker's default seccomp profile forbids: turn this on once the nodes allow it. Switching back to Legacy is always possible.

form.enabledDescription: Servers get a Subdomains page where players add names like play.example.com under the domains of Admin › Domains.
form.cloudflareTokenStored: A token is stored. Leave this empty to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.
form.cloudflareTokenMissing: No token yet. It needs Zone › Zone › Read and Zone › DNS › Edit on the domains.
form.defaultLimitDescription: Unless a server has its own limit (Admin › Servers › Subdomains).
form.costsDescription: While tokens are on, the server owner pays these for a server's first, second, third and every further subdomain, and gets them back when it is deleted. 0 is free.
form.blockedNamesDescription: Names nobody may take, besides the built-in ones (www, panel, mail and the like). Comma separated; * matches anything, so test* blocks every name starting with test.

form.enabledDescription: Players get a Discord Rewards page, and everything below applies. Needs the server ID.
form.guildIdDescription: The Discord server (guild) ID: turn on Developer Mode in Discord, then right-click the server › Copy Server ID.
form.botTokenDescription: A bot in the server with the Server Members intent on (Developer Portal › Bot), and Manage Server and Manage Roles for the invites and the two-boost role.
form.tokenStored: A token is stored. Leave this empty to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.
form.inviteUrlDescription: Where players join the server (https://discord.gg/…). Empty hides every invite link and button.
form.oauthProviderDescription: The OAuth provider (Admin › OAuth Providers) that signs in with Discord: a player's Discord account is the one they link through it. Not used while noprofit.space is connected.
form.tierDescription: Added to the allowance of everyone in the server, where the allowance has a limit (without noprofit.space; with it, its plans do this). CPU in % (100 is one thread), memory and disk in MiB. 0 adds nothing.
form.creditsPerInviteDescription: For every member who joins through someone's invite and stays. Paid while credits are on, without noprofit.space.
form.minAccountAgeDaysDescription: Days. A Discord account younger than this when it joins pays nothing (against alts).
form.inviteMaturityHoursDescription: Hours a reward is held; a member who leaves before then pays nothing. 0 pays at once.
form.inviteClawbackDescription: A paid invite whose member leaves later is taken back: from the balance, and what that cannot cover from the inviter's next invite rewards.
form.boostTwoCreditsDescription: In all, with the first. Each level pays once per account.
form.boostTwoRoleIdDescription: Discord does not say how often a member boosts: members with this role count as two boosts, and /setboost gives and takes it. Empty: two boosts only through /setboost.
form.subdomainsRequireLinkDescription: A server's owner needs a linked Discord account for new subdomains. Existing ones stay.
form.subdomainsRequireMemberDescription: A server's owner needs to be in the Discord server for new subdomains. Needs the bot token.
form.rewardsBotEnabledDescription: On the bot token: records who joined through whose invite and answers /invites, /topinvites and /setboost (administrators only). Off: nothing connects to Discord.
form.assistantBotEnabledDescription: On its own token. neo on Discord runs on it (Settings › AI › neo on Discord).
form.moderationBotEnabledDescription: On its own token. rux runs on it (Settings › Accounts › rux).

status.title: Bot Status
status.none: No bot is connected. Bots run on the primary instance only, a few seconds after they are turned on.
status.refused: refused by Discord, tried again in an hour or when its settings change

reason.members_intent: Server Members intent off: joins and leaves are missed

blocker.discord_off: The Discord tab is off or names no server.
blocker.bot_off: The Discord tab's moderation bot is off.
blocker.no_token: The Discord tab's moderation bot has no token.
blocker.no_server: No Discord server id (here or on the Discord tab).
blocker.switched_off: rux is switched off on noprofit.space (Admin › rux).
blocker.no_accounts: Nobody can be told an admin: without noprofit.space, Discord accounts are linked through the Discord tab's sign-in provider, and none is set.
blocker.no_ai: rux has no AI providers (neo's: set one up in neo's settings): rux cannot think.

status.startingDescription: The moderation bot connects on the primary instance a few seconds after it is turned on. If this stays, see the panel log.

reason.token: The token is wrong or was reset: put the new one on the Discord tab.
reason.intents: The intents are not allowed: turn on "Message Content Intent" under Discord Developer Portal › your application › Bot.
reason.closed: Discord closed the connection; it is tried again when the settings change.

status.noContent: rux is online without the Message Content intent
status.noContentDescription: DMs and @mentions work. Standing rules, watched channels and "hey rux" do not: turn on "Message Content Intent" under Discord Developer Portal › your application › Bot.

managed.title: Set up on {by}
managed.description: rux's settings are kept on {by} (Admin › rux) and shown here read-only. rux takes up a change there within a minute.

form.botDescription: rux takes orders from Discord accounts linked to {admins} (and moderation orders from members of the roles they make moderators), by DM, @mention or "hey rux". Its switch and token are the moderation bot's, on the Discord tab.
form.adminsPanel: an admin of this panel (one who linked Discord)
form.name: Name
form.nameDescription: What members call it ("hey rux") and what it calls itself. Letters, digits, dashes and underscores.
form.guildIdDescription: Defaults to the Discord tab's server. DMs to rux act on it until an admin picks another server.
form.timezoneDescription: Every time rux reads or writes is in this zone.
form.messagesPerMinuteDescription: How many orders one person may give a minute.
form.maxStepsDescription: How many model calls one order may take.
form.historyMinutesDescription: Minutes an order remembers of the conversation before it.
form.giveawayChannelIdDescription: On the main server. Used when an order names no channel.
form.modLogChannelIdDescription: On the main server. Every moderation action there is posted here.
form.creditGrantersDescription: Discord user IDs. Only they can have rux give someone credits; empty turns it off.
form.tokensCommandDescription: Members whose Discord is linked to an account see their tokens, today's streak and their membership, only for them.
form.giveawayMaxMembershipDaysDescription: For giveaways of days of a membership.
form.announceChannelIdDescription: On the main server. rux announces double-token windows here; empty: no announcements.
form.tokenBonusPostsDescription: Posts once when a double-token window (Admin › Settings › Economy › Tokens) starts.
form.serversDescription: rux can work on more servers with the same bot (invite it to each, see the invite links above). Each server has its own rules, watched channels, moderator roles, warnings, cases and giveaways; admins, the main admin and credits are the same everywhere. An order in a server acts on that server only; in a DM, an admin or moderator tells rux which server they mean. Removing a server stops rux there.
form.serverNameDescription: Who the server belongs to in rux's prompts, e.g. example.com. Empty: {app}.
form.serverAboutDescription: Completes "<name> is …", e.g. "a free VPS host". Empty: a free game server host.
form.serverTrustedDomainsDescription: More domains the checks treat as the host's own on this server, on top of "Our Own Sites".
form.warningsDescription: Warnings add up until an admin clears them. From the first number on, every new warning also times the member out; from the second, it bans them for a while. 0 turns a step off.
form.warnBanDescription: Like 24h; rux lifts the ban afterwards.
form.aiDescription: neo's providers, with neo's failover. Orders: {orders}. Message checks: {checks} (never the premium models; when these cannot answer, messages are not checked). A change in neo's settings reaches rux within a minute. It calls them directly, so no neo limits apply.
form.watchGuidelines: Watched Channels Also Enforce the Basic Guidelines
form.watchGuidelinesDescription: Scams, slurs, harassment, sexual content and advertising: deleted and warned.
form.spamEnabled: Catch Spam Automatically, in Every Channel
form.spamEnabledDescription: Flooding, the same message again and again, mass mentions and emoji walls: deleted and warned, without AI.
form.spamFloodMessagesDescription: This many messages from one member within the seconds next to it.
form.spamDuplicatesDescription: The same message this many times within the seconds next to it.
form.ruleCooldownSecondsDescription: Seconds between two actions of one standing rule on the same member.
form.trustedDomainsDescription: Domains the checks treat as this host's own on every server, never a scam or an advert, each with its subdomains (e.g. example.com). The panel's address and the Discord invite always count.
form.noprofitSecretDescription: Empty: the noprofit.space API secret. Set it when noprofit.space signs rux's routes with another secret.
form.secretStored: A secret is stored. Leave this empty to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.
form.secretMissing: No secret of its own yet.

page.title: neo on Discord
page.intro: neo answers account questions on the Discord server, for anyone, linked or not: in DMs, when @mentioned, when replied to, or, with name calls on, with "hey neo". For a server problem it sends people to neo in the panel. It runs as the assistant bot: turn it on, set its token and see its state on the Discord tab. It uses neo’s models, limits and retention days.

form.nameCallsDescription: Also answer messages on the server that start with the bot’s name ("hey neo, …"). Needs the Message Content Intent in Discord’s Developer Portal, or the bot cannot connect. Applies after a restart of the panel, or after turning the assistant bot off and on again on the Discord tab.
form.messagesPerMinuteDescription: How many messages one Discord account may send the bot a minute. The ones over it are ignored.
form.maxStepsDescription: Model calls one answer may take, account lookups included.
form.historyMinutesDescription: How old an earlier answer in the same channel may be for the bot to remember it.
form.historyTurnsDescription: How many earlier answers in the same channel the bot remembers. 0 remembers none.

page.title: Devboxes

form.enabledDescription: Servers get a VS Code page: a devbox next to the game server with its files at /server, reached over SSH or in the browser. Needs abuse protection on and the devbox egg below.
form.eggDescription: The egg devbox servers are made from (docs/eggs/devbox.json, imported into any nest).
form.imageDescription: Empty uses the egg's first image. A digest (…@sha256:…) pins one build. Running devboxes pick a change up at their next start.
form.membersOnlyDescription: Only members get a devbox (Economy › Memberships). Off: everyone.
form.resourcesDescription: On top of the game server's: CPU in % (100 is one thread), memory and disk in MiB.
form.premiumDescription: For a devbox paid by someone with the second membership.
form.idleMinutesDescription: Minutes without a connection before a devbox stops.
form.maxHoursDescription: Hours after its start a devbox stops, connected or not.
form.runningPerUserDescription: Devboxes one person may have running at once: their own and the shared ones on servers they own.
form.cleanupDaysDescription: Days without use after which a stopped devbox is deleted with its home.
form.panelUrlDescription: Where devboxes reach the panel. Empty: the panel's URL (Application).
form.webDomainDescription: Each devbox answers at https://<name>.<this domain> through the edge. A domain of its own, never the panel's. Empty switches the browser version off.
form.webOriginIpDescription: The edge's public IPv4. Each devbox gets a proxied DNS record pointing at it.
form.cloudflareTokenStored: A token is stored. Leave this empty to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.
form.cloudflareTokenMissing: No token: the subdomains token is used. It needs Zone › DNS › Edit on the browser domain.

page.certificatesStored: The devbox CA and the edge's certificate exist. Write them to the edge with panel-rs devboxes edge-certificates --dir <directory>. Replacing them needs the edge's files written again, and running devboxes a restart.
page.certificatesMissing: No certificates yet. VS Code in the browser needs them: the edge and the devboxes check each other with them.

toast.certificates: Certificates made. Write them to the edge again.

form.pauseEnabledDescription: A node over the line takes no new servers, for admins either, until it has been under the line for five minutes. A node paused by hand stays paused.
form.pausePercentDescription: Memory or CPU use above which a node is paused.
form.unreachableAfterDescription: Checks in a row a node may miss before it is paused. The panel checks every node once a minute.
form.diskPercentDescription: Disk use above which a node takes no new servers, moves or restores, even with Pause Busy Nodes off. 0 turns it off. A node that reports no disk use is never paused for it.
form.smallOffsetDescription: On a small node the line is this much lower, as one busy server weighs more there.
form.portRangesDescription: Ports the panel makes new allocations on when a node has no free one: for a new server, a move, a restore or a port a player adds. Ranges and single ports from 1024 up, comma separated; earlier ones are used first.

form.enabledDescription: A player's start waits its turn while the server's node is over the line or others are already waiting there, and every start waits while the shortest wait is above 0. Admins and the exempt roles never wait.
form.includeRestartDescription: A restart waits too; the server keeps running until its turn.
form.linePercentDescription: Memory or CPU use above which a node holds starts back. On a small node it is lower by the placement settings' offset.
form.minWaitDescription: Every start waits at least this long on the queue page, even on a quiet node, as on the Pelican panel. 0 queues starts on busy nodes only.
form.maxWaitDescription: After this a start goes out however busy the node is.
form.releaseIntervalDescription: A node lets one start go at a time and waits this long before it is measured for the next.
form.passMinutesDescription: After a start was let go, the server's next start within this time does not wait.
form.exemptRolesDescription: Members of these roles never wait, like admins.
form.moveOfferDescription: The queue page offers to move the server to the quietest other node of its location, when moving servers is on and the user may move this one.
form.moveRequiresMembershipDescription: Only accounts with a membership see the offer.
form.moveMaxDiskDescription: A move copies the whole server, so only servers with a disk limit under this are offered one; servers with unlimited disk never are. 0 offers it at any size.

form.enabledDescription: A server nobody used for a while is stopped, later backed up off its node and removed from it. Its owner restores it from the server page. Admins' servers are never touched.
form.stopMinutesDescription: A running server nobody used for this long is stopped.
form.parkMinutesDescription: A stopped server nobody used for this long is backed up and removed from its node.
form.maxPerRunDescription: How many servers are stopped and how many are parked each minute, at most.
form.exemptMembersDescription: Servers of accounts with a membership are never stopped or parked.
form.deleteAfterDaysDescription: A server parked for this long is deleted, with its files, unless its owner restored it first. Its backups go to the deleted servers' hold. 0 never deletes.
form.costEarlyDescription: What a restore costs soon after parking. 0 is free.
form.costLateDescription: What a restore costs after that. 0 is free.
form.costWindowHoursDescription: How long after parking the early price applies.

form.enabledDescription: Nothing shows until a zone, a tag or a sponsored banner exists. Admin pages never show ads. In-game messages have their own switch.
form.showAccountDescription: The server list, the account pages, Create Server and the store.
form.showServerDescription: A server's console and its other pages.
form.memberFreeDescription: The second membership sees no ads; the first sees only the waiting room before a start, no banners or popups. Off: members see every ad, refreshing slower.
form.slotTopDescription: The sponsored top banners (Admin › Sponsored Banners) above every page.
form.slotServerToolsDescription: A 468×60 or 320×50 banner under the header of a server's pages, not on the console.
form.slotPagesDescription: A 300×250 banner on Create Server, the store and the server list.
form.slotFootDescription: A leaderboard and the native unit at the foot of every page.
form.maxUnitsPerPageDescription: The most units the server pages strip and the page rectangles fill together on one page. 0 fills none of them.
form.refreshSecondsDescription: A unit that holds an ad reloads after this long in view. 0 never.
form.refreshMemberSecondsDescription: The same for the first membership, never shorter than the above. 0 never.
form.zonesDescription: Paste Adsterra's Banner snippets as they are, or one key:WIDTHxHEIGHT:host per line. Sizes: 728x90, 468x60, 320x50, 300x250, 160x600 and 160x300. Each slot gets the widest zone that fits it, and no zone shows twice on a page.
form.frameOriginDescription: Another address of this panel, best on another domain (https://ads.example.net), that serves only /api/ads/unit. The ad frames then load from it with an origin of their own, which some networks need to fill. Empty: they load from the panel's address, isolated.
form.nativeScriptDescription: The script URL or the whole snippet. Empty: no native unit.
form.nativeContainerDescription: The id of the snippet's empty div. Empty: taken from the script URL.
form.nativeHeightDescription: Pixels kept for the native unit.
form.socialBarScriptDescription: The script URL or the whole snippet. It runs in the page itself, not in a frame.
form.socialBarEverywhereDescription: Off: only in the waiting rooms, when they carry it. Never on the console.
form.popunderScriptDescription: Runs only in the waiting rooms, where players were told the ads pay for their server.
form.roomScriptDescription: A Social Bar or Vignette zone of the waiting rooms' own, so what they earn shows separately.
form.cspHostsDescription: Hosts the page scripts load further scripts from, one per line. The scripts' own hosts are allowed already.
form.monetagPushZoneDescription: The zone id from Monetag's In-Page Push tag. Empty: off.
form.monetagPushSrcDescription: The script URL from the same tag.
form.monetagVignetteZoneDescription: The zone id from Monetag's Vignette tag. Empty: off.
form.monetagVignetteSrcDescription: The script URL from the same tag.
form.monetagVignetteMinutesDescription: Per browser. 0: on every page load.
form.monetagVignetteMembersDescription: Off: members never get the Vignette. Monetag never loads on the console or in the waiting rooms.
form.monetagVerificationDescription: Monetag's verification code, put into the head of every page.
form.roomEnabledDescription: A player's start goes out at once, and the player waits on a page with ads while the server comes up. Admins and accounts without ads never wait.
form.roomCpuDescription: Servers with a CPU limit above this wait. 0: every server.
form.roomMemoryDescription: Servers with more memory than this wait. 0: every server.
form.roomDiskDescription: Servers with more disk than this wait. 0: every server.
form.roomMinSecondsDescription: The room lets the player through once the server runs and this much time has passed.
form.roomMaxSecondsDescription: After this the room lets the player through however far the server is.
form.roomPassMinutesDescription: After a room, the same player's starts of that server within this time do not wait.
form.roomBannerDescription: The zones the page has left, the 160×600 and 160×300 ones too. The start queue shows them as well.
form.roomNativeDescription: The native unit, once per page.
form.roomSocialBarDescription: The Social Bar from the Adsterra tab.
form.roomPopunderDescription: The Popunder from the Adsterra tab.
form.roomInterstitialDescription: The waiting room zone from the Adsterra tab.
form.dayPassEnabledDescription: The room offers "Skip the wait" for tokens: the user's starts skip every room, on all their servers, for a while.
form.dayPassHoursDescription: How long one pass lets starts skip the room; a pass bought early adds to what is left.
form.adblockEnabledDescription: On pages with ads, a visitor with an ad blocker is asked to allow them.
form.adblockModeDescription: Notice: a note at the top that can be closed. Modal: a dialog that can be closed after a few seconds. Block: a dialog that stays until the blocker is off.
form.adblockGraceDescription: How long the dialog stays before it can be closed.
form.adblockDismissHoursDescription: A closed notice or dialog stays away this long. 0: it is back on the next page load.
form.adblockProbeDescription: Also count it as blocked when the ad host does not answer the browser.
form.inGameEnabledDescription: Running Minecraft servers of accounts without the second membership get a chat message now and then, also while Show Ads is off.
form.inGameMessageDescription: One line. Empty: "This server is hosted on" and the panel's name.
form.inGameIntervalDescription: How often each server gets it.
form.promoEnabledDescription: A card at the window's corner for users without a membership who see ads: the membership closest to their tokens, its perks and how far they are. Never on an account's first day.
form.promoHoursDescription: A user sees it at most once in this time, on any device.
form.offersEnabled: Offers Where a Limit Is Felt
form.offersEnabledDescription: One line with a link on the start queue (the second membership goes first), on Create Server when the allowance is used up (the Resource Store) and on the Panel Access page (the memberships include it).
form.promoVideos: Promo Clips in the Ad Slots
form.promoVideosDescription: The clips in public/promo/ take turns with the other units, to the same audience: a video in the waiting rooms, the poster in the page rectangles. The first membership's clip never goes to members.
form.promoVideoShareDescription: How often a slot shows a clip instead of its unit; a slot with nothing else shows one too. 0: never.

form.enabledDescription: Users who have not finished or skipped it see a short guide over the server list, then over the first console they open. Turning it off hides it for everyone at once.
form.versionDescription: Raise it to show the tour again to everyone who already saw or skipped it, for example after the panel changed.

form.urlDescription: Where players write a review: the https link a review site gives for writing one. Players then see a prompt above their server list and a link in the account menu. Leave it empty to turn both off.
form.siteDescription: The review site's name as players see it. Empty: the review page's host name.
form.delayDaysDescription: How old an account with a server must be before the prompt shows. Everyone is asked the same way at the same point; staff (anyone with admin permissions) never are, as review sites forbid it.
form.intervalDaysDescription: How long the prompt stays away once a player closed or followed it. 0: it never comes back.

form.deletedHoldDaysDescription: How long the newest system backup of a deleted server stays downloadable from its owner’s Backups page. Older system backups of it are removed at once. 0 deletes them with the server.
form.failoverModeDescription: Whether a down node’s servers are restored on the other nodes of its location from their newest backup off the node (the node’s Failover tab).
form.failoverModeManual: By hand, from the node’s Failover tab
form.failoverModeNotify: By hand, and report a down node to the admins without restoring
form.failoverAfterDescription: How long a node must be unreachable (checked once a minute) before its servers are failed over, or the node is reported. One failover runs at a time, and only while most other nodes answer.
form.failoverParallelDescription: How many servers of one failover are moved and restored at the same time.

form.secretStored: Stored. Leave empty to keep it.
form.creditsEnabledDescription: Credits buy CPU, memory and disk in the Resource Store, and the second membership. With noprofit.space connected they are its credits. Turned off, the store is hidden; balances are kept.
form.startingCreditsDescription: Credits every account gets once, the first time its balance is shown (without noprofit.space).
form.storeDiscountDescription: Taken off every price the sale covers while it runs, with or without noprofit.space. 0 turns it off.
form.storeDiscountNameDescription: What the store calls the sale, such as Halloween special. Empty: Sale.
form.storeDiscountStartsDescription: In your browser’s time zone. Empty: right away.
form.storeDiscountEndsDescription: Shown in the store. Empty: until the discount is set back to 0.
form.storeDiscountCoversDescription: What the discount is taken off. Memberships: purchases, gifts and automatic renewals, with a banner on the Membership page.
form.tokensEnabledDescription: Tokens are earned through surveys and sponsored links and buy the memberships.
form.dailyTokensDescription: Tokens every account gets once a day, the first time it looks. 0 gives none.
form.panelAccessEnabledDescription: Accounts without a membership pay for the panel itself. They can still earn tokens, buy access, change their settings and log out.
form.panelAccessTokensDescription: Memberships and administrators never pay. 0 makes the panel free.
form.badgesEnabledDescription: Users buy preset badges on their account page, for good, and show one next to their name. Bought badges stay shown when this is off.
form.membershipEnabledDescription: Both are bought for some days at a time. The first opens the locations with the tier “plus”; the second gives everything the first does, opens the tier “premium” too and needs no first membership.
form.plusNameDescription: What players see, such as Plus.
form.plusplusNameDescription: What players see, such as Premium.
form.plusplusCreditsDescription: 0 does not sell it for credits.
form.plusBurstCoresDescription: CPU above each server’s limit, 100% per core, used while the node has it to spare. Outside the allowance and the store; paid CPU wins when the node is busy.
form.plusplusBurstCoresDescription: The total while it runs, not added to the first membership’s.
form.endsSoonEnabledDescription: A notification before a membership or paid panel access ends: when, whether it renews by itself and whether the balance covers it, with a Renew link. One per end.
form.autoRenewEnabledDescription: Members may have a membership renew by itself as it ends, at its price then (a sale included), while their balance covers it. Off for each membership until its member switches it on.
form.giftsEnabledDescription: Accounts may buy a membership for another account with tokens, at its normal or sale price. Tokens themselves are never given.
form.giftsPerDayDescription: Per buyer, over the last 24 hours.
form.bundleEnabled: Include a Membership on Another Panel
form.bundleEnabledDescription: While the second membership runs, the panel below gives the account its membership too, such as switched.cloud Plus with Premium, and the other way round its second membership includes the first one here (it posts to /api/memberships/bundle). Each panel tells the other within a minute of every change and once a day for every membership that runs. Needs noprofit.space: both panels know the account by its noprofit.space account.
form.bundleUrlDescription: Where the other panel is, starting with https://.
form.bundleNameDescription: What the Membership page lists under the second membership, such as switched.cloud Plus.
form.bundleSourceNameDescription: The other way round: the other panel’s membership that includes the first membership here, such as switched.cloud Premium.
form.bundleSecretDescription: At least 32 characters, the same on the other panel; it signs every request.
form.storeNote: Without noprofit.space: what a step costs and where prices climb. With noprofit.space its store and prices are used.
form.stepDescription: How much one step adds; 0 does not sell it. Memory and disk in MiB.
form.priceFloorDescription: The least a step costs on the way to the limit, in percent of its price.
form.softLimitDescription: Where prices get steep, in percent of the limit.
form.softMultiplierDescription: What a step costs at the soft limit, as a multiple of its price.
form.doublingDescription: Past the soft limit the price doubles every this many percent of the limit.
form.claimMinutesDescription: How long a player has to come back from a sponsored link.
form.linkDecayPercentDescription: Advertisers pay less for a person they already showed ads to: each further link a person finishes on the same provider the same day pays this many percent less than the one before. 0 pays every link in full.
form.linkFloorPercentDescription: A link never pays less than this share of its full reward, however many came before it that day.
form.linkvertiseEnabledDescription: Needs the anti-bypass API token from Linkvertise’s dashboard.
form.linkvertisePublisherDescription: For Linkvertise’s Full Script on the Tokens page. Without it, the link below is used.
form.linkvertiseWhitelistDescription: Patterns of the links the script turns into Linkvertise links, comma separated. Empty: lvr= (the Tokens page’s own link).
form.linkvertiseLinkDescription: A Linkvertise link to the panel; {returnPlain} or {returnB64} in it is replaced with the way back to the Tokens page.

form.alwaysConfirmDestructive: Always Ask Before Deleting or Killing
form.alwaysConfirmDestructiveDescription: Overrides a user's "without asking" choice for deletes and kill.

form.gatewayEnabledDescription: Off: neo answers nothing while it runs on this panel's models.
form.plusPercentDescription: The limits of the first membership, in % of the windows below (125 = 25% more).
form.plusplusPercentDescription: What the second membership adds on top of {plus}: 125 on 125 makes 156% of the windows below.
form.discordUnlinkedPercent: neo on Discord Without a Linked Account (% of These Limits)
form.discordUnlinkedPercentDescription: Discord accounts nobody linked get windows of their own at this share. Linked ones use their account's limits. 0: neo answers linked accounts only.
form.extraEnabledDescription: Once a window is used up, the chat offers one more day's worth (the long window's tokens divided by its days) on top of every running window, until it resets. Only while this panel meters neo and tokens are on.
form.extraTokensDescription: Taken from the account when the user buys it in the chat.
form.defaultCooldownDescription: How long a model that failed without saying when to try again is skipped. A rejected key is skipped for 10 minutes.
form.maxBusyWaitDescription: When every model is skipped for longer than this, neo reports an outage instead of asking to wait.
form.deadlineDescription: The longest one answer may take, every try included.
form.maxConcurrentDescription: Model calls in flight at once, for the whole panel.
form.toolsProbeDescription: Asks each model once (kept for 6 hours) whether the tools of a request reach it. One that drops them gets the tools described in its prompt instead.

rule.supportUrl: A link starting with https:// or http://.

models.hint: People pick a model in neo's chat by its label. A turn runs on the model it picked only; there is no failover to another model. Turns nobody picked a model for go to the models open to everyone, in slot order. A model that fails is skipped for a while.

models.descriptionDescription: A short line under the name in the picker, such as "Smartest model".
models.modelDescription: The model name the API knows.
models.endpointDescription: The API base (such as https://api.groq.com/openai/v1, or https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta for Google AI Studio) or the full URL, public https only; the format's path is added when missing. Google AI Studio takes the model from the Model field and the key from the API Key field, never from the URL.

models.apiKeyRemoved: The stored key is removed when you save.
models.timeoutDescription: How long one call may take.
models.dailyTokenCapDescription: 0 = no cap. Once reached, this model is skipped until tomorrow (UTC).
models.visionDescription: Screenshots go to the models that see images first; the others get a note in their place. Gemini and Claude models can, most Groq models cannot.

models.multiplierDescription: A turn on this model counts this many times its tokens.

software.label: Server software

descriptions.plugins: The standard server. Supports Bukkit, Spigot and Paper plugins.
descriptions.fabric: Lightweight mod loader. Use for Fabric mods.
descriptions.neoforge: Modern Forge fork. Use for NeoForge mods.
descriptions.forge: The classic mod loader. Use for Forge mods and older modpacks.

software.versionHint: Leave this on Latest and your server follows new Minecraft releases on its next reinstall.

modpack.label: Modpack
modpack.none: No modpack - just the plain server
modpack.card: A ready-made pack of mods. It brings its own loader and Minecraft version.
modpack.hint: A modpack brings its own loader and Minecraft version, so it overrides the two answers in the previous step. Packs that require one exact Forge or NeoForge build may still need manual work afterwards.
modpack.versionHint: The newest release is selected for you. Older versions exist for packs that are still being updated.

bedrock.yesDescription: Installs Geyser and Floodgate so Bedrock (mobile and console) players can join. Java players are unaffected.
bedrock.noDescription: Only the Java edition of Minecraft can connect. You can add Bedrock support later from the Mods page.
bedrock.note: Bedrock players connect on a separate port, shown on the server's connection details once it restarts. You can change or remove this any time from the Mods page.

accounts.premiumDescription: Every player is verified against Mojang. Skins, capes and usernames are guaranteed to be genuine. This is the safe default.
accounts.crackedDescription: Anyone can join with any username, without owning Minecraft. Choose this only if you know you need it.
accounts.crackedWarning: Careful: with cracked clients allowed, anyone can connect using your username - including operators. Keep the whitelist on, or your server will be taken over.

access.privateDescription: Only the players you list can join. Turns the whitelist on and enforces it, so removing someone also disconnects them.
access.publicDescription: No whitelist. Anyone who knows the address can connect.
access.publicWarning: A public server will be found by scanners within hours. Expect uninvited visitors, and keep backups.

players.whitelistHint: Minecraft usernames, not e-mail addresses. You can add more from the Players page at any time.
players.operatorsHint: Start with your own Minecraft username so you can run commands in game.
players.operatorsWarning: Operators can change anything on the server, including granting themselves items and banning other players. Only add people you trust.
players.placeholder: Type a username and press Enter

artifacts.sourceNote: Builds download straight from Cfx (runtime.fivem.net). {app} does not host or change them and is not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Cfx.re.

enhanced.title: FiveM for GTAV Enhanced
enhanced.subtitle: Run your server on the new GTAV Enhanced edition of FiveM, or switch back at any time.
enhanced.earlyAccess: FiveM for GTAV Enhanced is in early access at Cfx.re. Expect bugs and missing features, and test it before moving your community over.
enhanced.unavailable: FiveM for GTAV Enhanced is not available on {app} yet. Cfx.re has it in early access, and it does not run on our servers yet. Here is what will change once it does.
enhanced.redm: This is a RedM server. There is no Enhanced edition of RedM.
enhanced.runsLegacy: This server runs the normal FiveM server build.
enhanced.runsEnhanced: This server runs the Enhanced server build.
enhanced.runsEnhancedBuild: This server runs Enhanced build {build}, and updates to Cfx's newest at every start.
enhanced.pendingEnhanced: Switches to Enhanced at the next start.
enhanced.pendingLegacy: Switches back to FiveM (Legacy) at the next start.
enhanced.confirmEnhanced: Switch to FiveM for GTAV Enhanced?
enhanced.confirmEnhancedDescription: Only players with the Enhanced client can join afterwards. Your server files, database and txAdmin data stay as they are. A running server restarts now.
enhanced.confirmLegacyDescription: Players need the normal FiveM client again. Your server files stay as they are. A running server restarts now.

client.title: Players need the Enhanced client
client.description: Players must own GTA V Enhanced on PC and install the separate FiveM for GTAV Enhanced client from fivem.net. Legacy players cannot join an Enhanced server, and the other way round. There is no cross-play.

scripts.title: Scripts and resources
scripts.description: Lua, JavaScript and C# resources are compatible according to Cfx.re, and server.cfg, the database and txAdmin data stay untouched. ESX and QBCore are expected to work, but test your whole resource set before switching your live community.

assets.title: Assets, MLOs and vehicles
assets.description: Most addon vehicles, MLOs and clothing load normally. Enhanced uses the newer GTA V renderer, so custom shaders, graphics packs and some texture packs may look different or need an update from their creator.

network.title: Networking and performance
network.description: Enhanced ships an overhauled OneSync with higher sync rates, faster entity streaming and room for more players. Voice chat uses a new VOIP system, so external voice resources may need updates.

switching.title: Switching back
switching.description: You can switch back to FiveM (Legacy) at any time; your server files are kept either way. The Artifacts page only applies to Legacy: Enhanced always runs Cfx's current build (build {build} right now).

txadmin.title: txAdmin
txadmin.description: txAdmin keeps working on Enhanced with the same login and settings. Enhanced brings its own, newer txAdmin, so it may look slightly different.

frameworks.title: Framework installer
frameworks.subtitle: Install a FiveM framework with one click. Your current server files are kept.
frameworks.current: txAdmin runs {folder} now. Installing puts the framework in a new folder and keeps this one as it is.
frameworks.currentNone: txAdmin has not set this server up yet. Installing a framework does it for you.

frameworks.indexUnreachable: txAdmin's framework list could not be loaded. Try again in a minute.
frameworks.needsDatabase: Needs a database (one of your database slots).
frameworks.noDatabase: Needs a database, and this server has no database slot left.
frameworks.sourceNote: These are txAdmin's official recipes. Every file comes straight from the framework's own GitHub; {app} does not host or change them.

install.title: Install {recipe}
install.description: Everything downloads into a new folder while your server keeps running, then the server restarts on it. Your current files stay in {folder}.
install.descriptionFresh: Everything downloads into a new folder, then the server restarts on it.
install.serverNameDescription: Goes into the server's hostname. You can change it later under Server configuration.
install.licenseDescription: From portal.cfx.re (free). Filled in from your current server.cfg when it has one.
install.databaseDescription: The framework creates its tables here. A new one is the safe choice.

progress.needsAdmin: txAdmin starts the server once it has an admin: open the console, then open txAdmin on your server's second port and register with the PIN shown there.
progress.previousKept: Your previous files are still in {folder}.
progress.failedNote: Nothing changed on your server: the new folder and the database it created were removed, and txAdmin still runs your previous files.
